children: According to ChainCatcher, Inversion founder Santiago Roel Santos predicts ETH could fall into the $100s over the next two years. He said ETH has not reached that range because it still has a strong base of supporters, but believes a lack of coordination between Ethereum’s product and technical leadership, along with senior leaders’ dismissive stance toward DeFi, is weakening that support.
Santos contrasted Ethereum with Solana, which he said has taken the opposite approach, and cited Solana’s acquisition of CoinGecko.

title: Santiago Roel Santos Sees ETH Falling to the $100s Within Two Years
